newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algerian leader to visit Gulf, China, Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: Algerian leader to visit Gulf, China, Vietnam.

text.p: Algerian President Liamine Zeroual will travel to the Arab Gulf state of Bahrain on Tuesday at the start of a tour that will also take him to China, Vietnam and Qatar, the official Algerian news agency APS reported on Monday.
Zeroual's visit to Bahrain, at the invitation of the Gulf country's Emir Sheikh Isa bin Sulman al-Khalifa, would be the first such visit by an Algerian president.

Algeria's cooperation with Bahrain and its fellow Gulf Cooperation Council's member Qatar has been limited and economic relations between it and Qatar have only extended to the hiring of some Algerian gas and oil experts.

Qatar's ambassador in Algiers, Hussein Ali Edoursi told the Algerian daily Alalam Essiyassi that his country intended to broaden its links with the North African country by hiring more energy experts and teachers and opening air flights between Algiers and Doha.

Zeroual's five-day visit to China has already been announced by APS. It is at the invitation of President Jiang Zemin and will start on Thursday. Zeroual will then go on to Vietnam and visit Qatar on his way home.
